messages.author: 0ad5a33f4578e90b
messages.subject: error on setting legend.position
parts:
Hi,
I'm new to ggplot and grid graphics in general. I'm trying to move the legend on the right side of a bar plot to the bottom with the following code:

qplot(
data=fig2Bulls,
x=year, y=italianBankers,
geom="bar", stat="identity",
ylab="Total Papal Bulls Mentioning Italian Bankers",
xlab="",
fill=bonsignori
) +
theme_bw() +
coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,45),xlim=c(1242,1269))+
scale_fill_grey(start=.6,end=.3,name="",
labels=c("Total Mentioning Italian Bankers","Bonsignori Company Subset")
) +
opts(legend.position="bottom")


This throws the following error:

Error in grid.Call.graphics("L_setviewport", pvp, TRUE) :
Non-finite location and/or size for viewport


The same happens with "top" and "left", but not "right". I'm not sure what to do about this.
Any help would be appreciated.

Many thanks,
Peter


PS. Here's some an example data frame that gives me the errors:

fig2Bulls <- data.frame(
year=rep(1243:1268,2),
bonsignori=rep(c(TRUE,FALSE),each=length(1243:1268)),
italianBankers=c(
0,0,0,14,5,4,1,0,0,0,1,5,
11,1,0,0,0,0,4,11,12,0,10,11,1,0,
8,9,20,2,1,2,22,3,1,1,0,0,
8,0,0,0,2,1,2,9,30,33,28,8,1,0
)
)

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: error on setting legend.position
parts:
Hi Peter,

This is a known error and it's on my to do list (I accidentally broke
this code when rewriting the layout code). Unfortunately there's not
much you can do to work around the bug - although perhaps +
opts(legend.position = c(0.5, 0.5) might be a possibility.

Regards,

Hadley
